info.description:
CloudHub 2.0 environment for Resume AI Agent MCP Server.

**Before using:**
1. Deploy the app to CloudHub 2.0 via Runtime Manager
2. Note your CloudHub app URL from Runtime Manager dashboard
3. Update `mcpBaseUrl` to your actual URL e.g. `https://resume-ai-agent-api.shard.usa-e1.cloudhub.io`
4. MCP endpoint: POST `{{mcpBaseUrl}}/mcp`

**CloudHub URL format:**
`https://<app-name>.<shared-space-domain>.cloudhub.io`
